output_format.description: Output format: 'text' for human-readable, 'json' for structured JSON output

input_address.description: The IP address or network in CIDR notation to process

address_family.description: Explicitly set the IP version: 'ipv4', 'ipv6', or 'none' for auto-detection

geoinfo_enabled.description: Whether to enable geographic information lookup (--geoinfo)

requested_fields.description: List of specific fields to output in VAR=VALUE format (e.g., ['address', 'network', 'prefix']). If empty and not JSON, all info is shown.

split_prefix.description: Prefix length for network splitting (-S option). 0 means no splitting.
